subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class remember/recall/review/edit/forget operator facade in the default memory slot now, route this to plugin/ClawHub packages, or wait until the schema/provenance/write/review companion issues converge?
rationale: The requested work adds user-facing command and skill/API surface across durable memory lifecycle semantics, while current main already has overlapping but incomplete plugin-specific memory surfaces.

options.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
options.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory-plugin facade.

options.title: Route To Plugin Or ClawHub
options.body: Close core work if maintainers decide Engram, Memory Wiki, LanceDB, or another package is the correct product boundary and no SDK gap remains.

options.title: Implement Immediately In Memory Core
options.body: Add the commands/tools now, accepting the risk of duplicating existing plugin surfaces or locking lifecycle semantics early.

recommendation.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Leave this open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory-plugin facade.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history on the memory slot, memory-core extraction, and plugin-boundary policy relevant to this decision.
